owner_decisions.privacy: STRICT_LOCAL_FIRST; user media and detailed local logs stay on owner-controlled nodes; outbound data requires explicit task-level authorization
owner_decisions.backup: encrypted backups on owner-controlled nodes; keys separated from backup storage; integrity verification and periodic restore tests
owner_decisions.updates: staged updates with automatic compatibility/provenance checks, mandatory gates, controlled activation and rollback
owner_decisions.queues: GitHub engineering queue/control/evidence separated from local media queue
owner_decisions.networking: protected outbound by default; private node-to-node transfer only for explicitly authorized tasks; no public inbound by default
owner_decisions.observability: detailed operational telemetry local; minimized source-bound engineering evidence in GitHub
owner_decisions.recovery: check lease/fencing, existing output, idempotency and replacement-executor compatibility before retry
owner_decisions.scheduling: adaptive resource management; P0 interactive, P1 normal user, P2 background engineering, P3 batch/maintenance
owner_decisions.models: catalog/manifests in GitHub; approved weights locally replicated to suitable nodes; large weights excluded from ordinary Git history

constraints: Functional Baseline 2.0 remains the accepted immutable functional reference
Jarvis does not replace ASTRA GOLD A0 for complex engineering decomposition
GitHub Supervisor/controller does not replace ASTRA GOLD A0
MediaHub Product State Authority remains sole canonical product-state mutation authority
No direct Gemini dispatch; approved controller and mandatory gates only
No implicit paid fallback, provider eligibility, free quota, fixed egress or region assumptions
Contour B only after Contour A deployment and independent acceptance
Documentation is not implementation, verification, qualification or acceptance
